	<ResortReportHeadline>Another dusting, snowmaking and more great turns!</ResortReportHeadline>
	<ResortReport><p>Yesterday's on and off snow flurries made for some really fun turns and after another dusting in the last 24hrs today should be heaps of fun too.</p><p>The current temp is a -3.2 and the forecast top is 0 degrees. There's some high cloud above and right now there's a moderate wind out of the WNW which is bringing the windchill down to a chilly -10.8.&nbsp;</p><p>With the drop in temps the snow guns have had a run, and I can see they're still going up on the Summit now. I reckon the groomers will be in great shape first up this morning - perfect for getting your edges into. Off-piste will be variable and may have firmed up overnight so properly assess it before getting too adventurous.</p><p>All in all it should be another really fun day on the hill. Have a great day!</p><p>Cheers, Burner.</p><p><br></p></ResortReport>
